evidence_quotes:
A separate oil cooler is mounted in front of the radiator.  This cooler is divided into two parts.
The top half is for transmission oil.
statements.reason: The separate cooler’s top half is designated for transmission oil.
statements.statement: In the separate oil cooler, the upper half cools transmission oil.

evidence_quotes:
A separate oil cooler is mounted in front of the radiator.  This cooler is divided into two parts.
The top half is for transmission oil.  The bottom half is for engine oil.
statements.reason: The separate cooler’s bottom half is designated for engine oil.
statements.statement: In the separate oil cooler, the lower half cools engine oil.

evidence_quotes: 1S THE ENGINE OIL PRESSURE 40-45 PSI AT 2000 RPM AND THE ENGINE WARM ? TEST OPTIONS 1. OIL PRESSURE GAUGE 2. STE/ICE-R TEST 50 (Page 2-739)
statements.reason: The lubrication-test chart gives 40–45 psi at 2000 RPM as the engine-oil-pressure test value.
statements.statement: At 2,000 RPM, the lubrication-test chart shows an engine-oil pressure of approximately 40–45 psi.
